Alış ve satış fiyatı ne demek?: What do the buying and selling prices mean?
<strong>Alış fiyatı</strong>, banka ya d: The buying price is what a bank or exchange office pays you for your currency — the amount you get when you sell your dollars. The selling price is what they charge when they sell currency to you. The selling price is always higher than the buying price. The gap between them is called the spread, and it is how they make money.
Bu yüzden 100 dolar alıp hemen geri bozd: So if you buy 100 dollars and sell them straight back, you lose a few lira even if the rate has not moved at all. The spread is narrow while the market is open and wide in the evening and at weekends. That is why prices in banking apps look worse outside working hours.
Buradaki kur ile bankamdaki kur neden fa: Why is the rate here different from my bank's?
Tabloda gördüğün fiyatlar serbest piyasa: The prices in the table are average free-market buying and selling prices. Every bank and exchange office adds its own spread on top. In Turkey, buying foreign currency also incurs a foreign exchange tax (BSMV) on the amount, which raises the total you pay. So the price at your bank will be somewhat different from the one here. For large amounts it pays to compare a few providers.
Çeviricide üç seçenek var. <strong>Döviz: The converter has three options. I'm buying currency uses the selling price, I'm selling currency uses the buying price and Average uses the midpoint. When converting between two foreign currencies (e.g. euro → dollar) it calculates a cross rate via their lira values. The result is approximate; what you actually get depends on the price of the institution you deal with.
Merkez Bankası kuru nedir?: What is the central bank rate?
Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası (TCMB): The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (CBRT) publishes indicative exchange rates every working day in the afternoon. These rates are used in official transactions, tax calculations, invoices and contracts. The live free-market price can drift away from the CBRT rate during the day. The chart on this page is based on daily reference rates of this kind, while the table shows market prices.
Tablo, sayfa açık kaldığı sürece iki dak: The table refreshes every two minutes while the page is open. The source's last update time is shown at the top of the page. Markets are closed at weekends, so prices barely move then.

Altın türleri arasındaki fark: The difference between types of gold
Türkiye'de altın, birikim aracı olarak e: In Turkey, gold is mostly bought as a savings tool in the form of gram gold and gold coins (quarter, half, full). The main differences between them are carat (purity) and weight.
<strong>Gram altın:</strong> 24 ayar, ya: Gram gold: 24 carat, i.e. almost pure gold. It is sold as bars or small packs. With little craftsmanship cost, it has the narrowest buy–sell spread.
<strong>Çeyrek altın:</strong> 22 ayar,: Quarter gold: 22 carat, about 1.75 grams. The most common gift at weddings and holidays.
<strong>Cumhuriyet altını ve Ata altın:<: Republic and Ata gold: coins minted by the State Mint, 22 carat and weighing about 7.2 grams.
<strong>14 ve 18 ayar altın:</strong> Ta: 14 and 18 carat gold: used in jewellery. 585 parts per 1000 of 14-carat gold and 750 per 1000 of 18-carat gold are pure gold.
<strong>Ons altın:</strong> Uluslararası: Gold ounce: the unit used on international markets; one ounce is about 31.1 grams and its price is quoted in dollars.
Ayar, bir altın alaşımının 24 parçasında: Carat shows how many of 24 parts of a gold alloy are pure gold. 24 carat is pure gold, while 22 carat means 22 of 24 parts are gold (about 916 per thousand). The rest is metals such as copper and silver added to make the gold more durable. The lower the carat, the lower the price.
Gram altın fiyatı nasıl oluşur?: How is the price of gram gold set?
Gram altının TL fiyatı iki şeye bağlıdır: The lira price of gram gold depends on two things: the ounce gold price on international markets and the dollar/lira rate. Roughly, it is the ounce price multiplied by the dollar rate and divided by 31.1. So even if the ounce price stands still, gram gold rises when the dollar rises. When both go up at the same time, gram gold climbs fastest.
Alırken ve bozdururken nelere dikkat etm: What to watch for when buying and selling
Kuyumcuların fiyatı, tabloda gördüğün pi: Jewellers' prices differ from the market price in the table. With gold coins, a craftsmanship charge is added to the price.
Alış ve satış arasındaki fark, çeyrek gi: The gap between buying and selling is larger for small coins such as the quarter than for gram gold. If you trade often, take this gap into account.
Eski tarihli ziynet altınları genelde ye: Older-dated gold coins are usually bought back at a slightly lower price than newly dated ones.
Bankalardaki altın hesaplarında fiziksel: With gold accounts at banks you do not receive physical gold; trading hours and spreads vary from bank to bank.
Ana sonuç satış fiyatıyla hesaplanır; ya: The main result uses the selling price, i.e. roughly what you would pay to buy that amount of gold. Below it, the approximate amount you would get when selling your gold (at the buying price) is shown too.
The prices in the table are market averages. Jewellers add their own margin and, for coins, a craftsmanship charge. Small differences between cities and jewellers are normal.

<strong>Hissedilen sıcaklık</strong>, te: Feels-like temperature is not what the thermometer shows but what your body senses. Wind makes cold air feel colder and humidity makes hot air feel more oppressive. On a windy winter day, 5 degrees can feel like 0.
<strong>Yağış ihtimali</strong>, o saat: Chance of precipitation is the probability of measurable rain or snow at your location in that hour or day. 30 percent does not mean “it will rain for 30 percent of the day”; it means that under similar conditions it rained on three days out of ten. At 60 percent or more, taking an umbrella makes sense.
<strong>Rüzgâr hızı</strong> yerden 10 m: Wind speed is the average speed 10 metres above the ground. Under 20 km/h is light, around 40 km/h is strong and 60 km/h or more is gale level.
Hava tahminleri, atmosferi sayısal model: Weather forecasts come from supercomputers that calculate the atmosphere with numerical models. Forecasts for the next one to three days are usually accurate. After the fourth day uncertainty grows; it is better to treat the seventh day as a trend. The exact place and time of local events such as showers and thunderstorms cannot be known for certain even a day ahead.
Dağlık bölgelerde ve kıyı şeridinde, bir: In mountainous areas and along the coast, the weather can change noticeably within a few kilometres. That is why searching your district rather than the provincial centre gives more accurate results.

Büyüklük ve şiddet aynı şey değil: Magnitude and intensity are not the same
<strong>Büyüklük</strong>, depremin kayn: Magnitude measures the energy released at the source of an earthquake and is a single value for each quake. That is the number in the list. Intensity describes how strongly the quake was felt and how much damage it caused at a particular place; it decreases with distance from the epicentre. The same earthquake can be felt strongly in one province and only lightly 200 kilometres away.
Büyüklük ölçeği logaritmiktir. Büyüklükt: The magnitude scale is logarithmic. Each one-unit increase in magnitude means roughly 10 times more ground motion and about 32 times more energy released. So a magnitude 6 earthquake releases about a thousand times more energy than a magnitude 4.
Büyüklüklere göre kabaca ne beklenir?: What to expect, roughly, by magnitude
<strong>3,0'ın altı:</strong> Genellikle: Below 3.0: usually not felt, only recorded by instruments. Happens dozens of times a day in Turkey.
<strong>3,0 – 3,9:</strong> Merkeze yakı: 3.0 – 3.9: felt lightly near the epicentre; no damage expected.
<strong>4,0 – 4,9:</strong> Geniş bir al: 4.0 – 4.9: felt over a wide area, objects shake; damage is rare.
<strong>6,0 ve üzeri:</strong> Yerleşim: 6.0 and above: can cause serious damage and loss of life if near populated areas.
Derinlik, depremin yerin kaç kilometre a: Depth shows how many kilometres below the surface an earthquake started. Shallow earthquakes (about 0–20 km) release their energy close to the surface, so they are felt more strongly and cause more damage than deep ones of the same magnitude. Most earthquakes in Turkey are shallow.
Kandilli ve AFAD verileri neden farklı o: Why can Kandilli and AFAD data differ?
Türkiye'de depremleri iki kurum izler: B: Two institutions monitor earthquakes in Turkey: Boğaziçi University's Kandilli Observatory and AFAD. Because they use different station networks and calculation methods, the magnitude and location of the same quake may be reported with small differences. Values given in the first minutes are updated as more station data comes in. This page shows Kandilli's list.
Sarsıntı sırasında <strong>çök, kapan, t: During shaking, drop, cover and hold on: get down next to a sturdy object, protect your head and neck, and stay put until the shaking stops.
Merdivenlere, balkona ve asansöre yönelm: Do not head for stairs, balconies or lifts; keep away from windows and things that could fall over.
Sarsıntı bittikten sonra gaz, elektrik v: Once the shaking stops, turn off the gas, electricity and water, and leave the building calmly.
Acil durumda <strong>112</strong>'yi ara: In an emergency call 112. To keep lines free, contact your loved ones by text message or over the internet.
Evde bir deprem çantası bulundur: su, da: Keep an earthquake kit at home: water, long-lasting food, a torch, a whistle, first-aid supplies, a power bank and copies of important documents.
Sayfa açık kaldığı sürece iki dakikada b: It refreshes every two minutes while the page is open. An earthquake appears here shortly after Kandilli publishes it, though there may be a delay of a few minutes.
Bir depremin konumunun ve büyüklüğünün h: Calculating and publishing an earthquake's location and magnitude takes a few minutes. Wait a little and refresh the page. Very small or very distant earthquakes may not be listed.

Namaz vakitleri — İmsak, öğle, ikindi, a: Prayer times — Imsak, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha times
Şehrini seç; bugünün namaz vakitlerini,: Choose your city; see today's prayer times, the time left until the next prayer and the monthly timetable. Using the Diyanet calculation method.
Şehrini ya da ilçeni seç; bugünün vakitl: Choose your city or district; see today's times and the whole month.
Namaz vakitleri güneşin gökyüzündeki kon: Prayer times are calculated from the position of the sun in the sky. That is why they shift by a minute or two every day and begin earlier in eastern cities than in western ones. There is more than an hour's difference between the far east and the far west of Turkey.
<strong>İmsak:</strong> Tan yerinin ağar: Imsak: the moment dawn begins to break. The time of the morning prayer begins, and for those fasting, eating and drinking stop.
<strong>Güneş:</strong> Güneşin doğduğu: Sunrise: the moment the sun rises. The time of the morning prayer ends.
<strong>Öğle:</strong> Güneşin gün içind: Dhuhr: the moment the sun passes its highest point of the day and begins to move west.
<strong>İkindi:</strong> Bir cismin gölg: Asr: the moment an object's shadow reaches its own height plus the length of its shadow at noon.
<strong>Akşam:</strong> Güneşin battığı: Maghrib: the moment the sun sets. The fast is broken at this time.
<strong>Yatsı:</strong> Batı ufkundaki k: Isha: the moment the red glow on the western horizon disappears.
Bu sayfadaki vakitler, Diyanet İşleri Ba: The times on this page are calculated with the angle values used by Turkey's Presidency of Religious Affairs (18° for imsak, 17° for isha). Still, they may differ by a few minutes from the official calendar published by Diyanet, because Diyanet adds a safety margin (temkin) to the calculated times and uses separate coordinates for each province and district.
İftar ve imsak gibi dakikanın önemli old: When the minute matters, as with iftar and imsak, rely on the official times of the Presidency of Religious Affairs.
Sayfada bugünün hicri tarihi de gösteril: The page also shows today's Hijri date. The Hijri calendar is lunar and about 11 days shorter than the solar year. That is why Ramadan and the religious holidays come about 11 days earlier in the Gregorian calendar each year.
Evet. Arama kutusuna ilçenin adını yaz v: Yes. Type the district's name into the search box and pick it from the list. Times are calculated for the coordinates of the place you choose.
Cihazının saatine göre çalışır. Farklı s: It works by your device's clock. If you chose a city in a different time zone, the countdown may be off; the prayer times themselves are in that city's local time.

Tablodaki fiyatlar ne anlama geliyor?: What do the prices in the table mean?
Kripto paraların tek bir resmî fiyatı yo: Cryptocurrencies have no single official price. On each exchange the price differs slightly depending on the orders of buyers and sellers at that moment. The values in this table are an average of prices across many exchanges, weighted by trading volume. The price on the exchange you use may differ slightly.
TL fiyatı, dolar fiyatının güncel kurla: The lira price is the dollar price converted at the current rate. On Turkish exchanges, pairs traded in lira may be slightly above or below this value depending on demand.
Kripto piyasası 7 gün 24 saat açıktır, t: The crypto market is open 24/7, it is small compared with the stock and currency markets, and prices are driven largely by expectations. That is why moves of 5–10 percent in a day are normal; for small coins they can be much larger.
Tablodaki Tether (USDT) gibi stabil krip: Stablecoins such as Tether (USDT) in the table aim to keep their value pegged to the dollar. Their price is expected to stay around 1 dollar, so you will see values very close to zero in the change column. They are usually used as an intermediate currency when trading on crypto exchanges.
Kripto varlıklar yüksek risklidir; yatır: Crypto assets are high-risk; you can lose all the money you invest.
“Garantili kazanç” vaat eden kişi ve pla: Do not trust people or platforms that promise “guaranteed profits”; such promises are the most common sign of fraud.

Türkiye'deki resmî tatil günleri: tarih,: Public holidays in Turkey: date, day of the week and days remaining. Including the dates of Ramadan Feast and Feast of Sacrifice.
Bu yılın ve gelecek yılın resmî tatil gü: This year's and next year's public holidays and the time left until the next one.
Türkiye'de resmî tatiller iki gruba ayrı: Public holidays in Turkey fall into two groups: national and general holidays, whose dates are the same every year, and religious holidays, whose dates change every year.
<strong>23 Nisan:</strong> Ulusal Egemen: 23 April: National Sovereignty and Children's Day
<strong>19 Mayıs:</strong> Atatürk'ü Anm: 19 May: Commemoration of Atatürk, Youth and Sports Day
<strong>15 Temmuz:</strong> Demokrasi ve: 15 July: Democracy and National Unity Day
<strong>29 Ekim:</strong> Cumhuriyet Bay: 29 October: Republic Day (the afternoon of 28 October is also a holiday)
<strong>Ramazan Bayramı:</strong> Arife: Ramadan Feast: starts on the afternoon of the eve; 3.5 days in total.
<strong>Kurban Bayramı:</strong> Arife g: Feast of Sacrifice: starts on the afternoon of the eve; 4.5 days in total.
Dinî bayramlar hicri takvime göre belirl: Because religious holidays follow the Hijri calendar, they come about 11 days earlier in the Gregorian calendar each year. So a holiday that falls in midsummer one year shifts to spring a few years later.
Tatil hafta sonuna denk gelirse ne olur?: What happens if a holiday falls on a weekend?
Türkiye'de resmî tatil hafta sonuna denk: In Turkey, when a public holiday falls on a weekend it is not automatically moved to the next working day. In some years, when a religious holiday falls so that it joins a weekend, the days in between may be declared administrative leave for public employees, extending the holiday. This decision is announced separately each time and is not binding on the private sector.
İş Kanunu'na göre ulusal bayram ve genel: Under the Turkish Labour Law, whether employees work on national and general holidays is set by contract. Full pay is due for a holiday not worked; if the employee works, an extra day's pay is due for each holiday. Check your employment contract and workplace practice for your own situation.
İçinde bulunduğumuz yılın tüm tatillerin: It shows all of this year's holidays and next year's holidays. The next holiday is highlighted in the table.
Arife günleri ve 28 Ekim öğleden sonrası: Half-day holidays such as holiday eves and the afternoon of 28 October may not appear as separate rows in the source. You can see which holidays begin with a half day in the explanation above.
Hayır. Bu sayfa yalnızca resmî tatilleri: No. This page shows only public holidays; for mid-term and semester breaks, check the Ministry of National Education's school calendar.
Tarihler Nager.Date açık veri servisinde: Dates come from the Nager.Date open data service. If a religious holiday date differs by a day from the official announcement, go by the official announcement.

Oyunlar ve projeler — Abyss Diver, LexiR: Games and projects — Abyss Diver, LexiRace, Spythere and more
Kanan Rahimov'un tarayıcıda ücretsiz oyn: Free browser games and web apps by Kanan Rahimov: Abyss Diver, LexiRace, Spythere, QR Car Connect, Nebula Drift and more.
İndirmeden, tarayıcıda açılan oyunlar ve: Games and apps that open in your browser, no download needed. Tap a card to open the project in a new tab.
Gizli sayıyı en kısa sürede bul. Mantığı: Find the secret number as fast as you can. You narrow down your guesses using logic and intuition. Ideal for short breaks.
Kaydırarak beğenme özelliğiyle tasarlanm: A dating app prototype designed around swipe-to-like. Made as an interface and interaction experiment.
El yapımı mum atölyesi için hazırlanmış: A simple, warm landing page design made for a handmade candle workshop.
Abyss Diver, eski cep telefonlarındaki d: Abyss Diver is a 2D adventure game inspired by the diving games on old mobile phones. You guide a diver down into the depths of the ocean and find your way through a different map on every level. There are 50 levels; each is designed differently from the last and the difficulty rises gradually. It is made with pixel graphics and played in the browser on phones and computers.
LexiRace, İngilizce kelime dağarcığını g: LexiRace is a word race for Turkish speakers who want to build their English vocabulary. The game goes through the letters of the alphabet in turn: you see the Turkish definition of a word and say the right English word starting with that letter out loud before time runs out. Answers are recognised with the browser's speech recognition, so pronunciation is part of the practice.
Kelimeler A1'den C2'ye kadar seviyelere: Words are grouped into levels from A1 to C2. There is a daily challenge played once a day, a Hard Mode where the letter can be at the start, middle or end of the word, one-on-one duels and Word Match, a mini game based on matching Turkish and English. You can add the words you miss to review cards and study them later. The game is designed especially for phones.
Spythere, arkadaş grubuyla oynanan bir p: Spythere is a party game played with a group of friends. Each player joins the room from their own phone. The players are shown a secret location; only the spy doesn't know it. Players ask each other questions about the location: the spy tries to work out the location without giving themselves away, while the others try to find the spy. The game ends with everyone voting on who the spy is.
QR Car Connect, araç sahipleri için bir: QR Car Connect is a contact solution for car owners. Anyone who scans the QR sticker on your car's window can reach you without seeing your phone number — for example when your car is blocking someone in. Stickers are 10×5 cm and come in landscape and portrait versions. You can also upload your own background image and design your sticker yourself.
Nebula: Infinite Drift neon görünümlü bi: Nebula: Infinite Drift is a neon-styled space game, Magma Runner a fast-paced running game and Guess the Number a number-guessing game for short breaks. Flamenear and Luna Candles are prototypes made as interface design experiments.
